verdict.rationale: Firecrawl runs work asynchronously in the background: async batch scraping, crawls and agent jobs, with webhooks firing as a crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent job or monitor check starts, progresses or finishes. The mention of "monitor check" hints at recurring automated checks, but the evidence does not document how users configure scheduled or triggered automations. missing for 10: documented scheduling or recurring-job configuration, detail on monitors as user-defined automations, independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended background workflows.
